hdDerivPathModal:
A derivation path is a piece of data which tells a Hierarchical Deterministic (HD) wallet how to derive multiple accounts from the same Secret Recovery Phrase. 

Derivation paths are used as a Bitcoin standard and allows you to theoretically create millions of addresses from the same phrase.
